headword: {万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}

definitions.explanation: Shouting banzai three times in unison with both arms raised, led by one person, to celebrate an election win, a wedding, a send-off, or the close of a formal gathering.

examples.japanese: {万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{締|し}めた→締める：10057_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: We closed with three cheers of banzai.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まり→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧、⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こった→起こる：01910_okoru⟧。
examples.english: When the win was confirmed, three cheers of banzai went up at the campaign office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音頭|おんど}→音頭：09782_ondo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{両手|りょうて}→両手：09518_ryoute⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧{万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Led by the company president, everyone raised both hands and gave three cheers of banzai.

notes:
⟦{万歳|ばんざい}→万歳：04339_banzai⟧ + ⟦{三唱|さんしょう}→三唱：31156_sanshou⟧ (calling out three times). One person leads with a short speech and the first call; everyone then shouts ばんざい three times, raising both arms each time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give three cheers of banzai
- {万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧: to close (a gathering) with banzai cheers
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音頭|おんど}→音頭：09782_ondo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}: banzai cheers led by ~

CULTURAL NOTE:
Typical at election victories, weddings, farewell parties and imperial celebrations. Another common way to close a gathering is clapping in rhythm, {一本締|いっぽんじ}め or {三本締|さんぼんじ}め.
